spots.text: After the first tunnel, you will see a ramp. Use it to smash through the bridge above you. It's hard to miss unless you actively jump over the ramp.
After the previous bridge, go around the next corner and jump using the R2 button to reach the can and smash the bridge.
Once you reach the part with the tracks on the water, always stick to the left side to get it.
After the water section, you will go through a cave. Just keep pressing the R3 button to blow the horn as you go through it.

items.title: Scare the Bats in the Cave

spots.text: After the cave section, you will be back outside. After the first corner, the tracks will split. Stick to the left and take the jump. You will soon reach the can in the middle of the tracks.

Soon after the previous can, you will have to manually jump over a red sign in the middle of the tracks and then land near a lighthouse. Here, stick to the right, then use the jump at the end on the left side to get the can.
On top of one of the Moai heads. Press L2+R2 once you are over it to drop down to it.
After picking up the film roll, you will use a jump to get over the remaining Moai heads. Just perform any trick over them.
Self-explanatory. Just hold the L2 button when going around a corner, then release it once the marker hits the green area.
Self-explanatory. Don't crash during the level.

levels.name: Seaside Showdown
levels.song: Wanman ☆ Clash ~ワンマン ☆ クラッシュ~

spots.text: Just after the first corner, you will jump over a giant sandcastle. Press L2 + R2 as you go over it to smash down and destroy it.
After the next corner, stick to the left to reach the lower area with the spray can.
You will see it in plain sight on the left side just after going upside down, soon after the previous spray can.
During the section where you ride the Ferris wheel, you will see antennas. They are all on the main path. Destroy 10 of them.
You will see it above you during the section where you ride the Ferris Wheel through the water. Press R2 to jump to it.
After the ferris wheel section, you will enter a lava filled cave. As soon as you land inside, stick to the right side to find the can.
Soon after the previous can, you will use a jump and then see a green sign on your right telling you to stick right for a can. Do so until you see the can. You will have to jump to reach it.
Self-explanatory. Do three different tricks in a row. They do not have to be during the same jump.

items.title: Perform 3 Different Tricks in a Row

spots.text: Just move out of the way and change track just as you are about to hit something. This also works with the fireballs near the end of the level.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end without crashing.

levels.name: Kumamoto Castle
levels.note: Here you will be able to spend your spray cans to purchase stickers needed for the Full Set trophy.

spots.text: During this level, you will have single rails you can grind on. Just keep the marker in the green and get 100 points in a single grind.

items.title: Score Over 100 Points on a Single Grind's Sweet Spot

spots.text: After the first few grind rails, you will jump and smash through a window. Just use the right analog stick to do any trick as you smash it.
Self-explanatory. Just do this trick during any jump. Pause the game to see the combination.
After smashing through the window, stay on the left track and jump over the red board to get the can (don't swap over to the right-side track).

After exiting the building and almost hitting a billboard, which you have to dodge by pressing L2+R2, you will then go around a few corners and then see the spray can above the two red boards in the middle of the tracks.
After the previous can, you will enter another large building. You will see the can above the tower of boxes inside.
After leaving the building, you will grind around a corner and then have to jump over the red board at the end. As soon as you do, press L2+R2 to drop down to the can.
Obtained automatically on one of the jumps during the last section when the camera is looking behind you.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the very start, jump before the corner to get to the grind rail in front of you, where you will find the can at the end.
Just after the previous can, you will jump over a zeppelin. Press L2+R2 while you are right above it to bounce off it.

After the zeppelin, you will jump to the tracks below (watch out for the electric wires). You will then see a green sign telling you to keep left for a spray can. After going left, jump up to the grind rail on your right to get the can.
After the previous can, you will go around a corner to the left. During the next downhill slope, jump up to the rail on your right to get the can.

After the previous can, you will go around a corner and then go over a bridge. Just before you get to the bridge, jump, then press left to land on the left side grind rail that goes over the bridge, where you will see the can.

Continue through the level a little until you go through a building. The game will slow down a little and the "horn" symbol will appear in the middle of the screen as you go through the building. Press R3 to blow the horn to complete the dare.
Close to the end of the level, you will ride a boat and then, with the boat, be on the side of a wave. Press R2 to jump off the top of the wave and perform any trick.

items.title: Trick While on the Sea Wave

spots.text: On top of the wave, as you ride the boat, press R2 to reach it.
Self-explanatory. Get a total of 500 points from grinding.

items.title: Score Over 500 Points From Grind Sweet Spots

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Kyushu Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Here you will be able to spend your film rolls to fill in the comic. Once it is filled, you will get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to fill it in on your first visit since you will need more film rolls from later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

levels.name: Glow Up
levels.note: This level is more open than the rest, and you get a little more freedom to finish the objectives and collect things in the order you like.

spots.text: From the start, stay on the default path until you see the three signs telling you where things are. Here, stick to the left side, then continue until you see another three signs. Also stick to the left, and you will collect the piece of Castella automatically after the next corner.
After the previous piece of Castella, take the jump and then stick to the right, following the blue and pink signs. This will take you to the Molty Statue.

After the Molty Statue, you will return to the start where the track splits. Take the same path as before to get to where you picked up the first piece of Castella. After the jump, this time stick to the left side and follow the green sign. You will then use a vertical ramp to collect the piece of Castella, then land on the rail below. During this jump, do a trick for the vert ramp dare.
After the previous collectible, you will see balloons on the track. Just do a trick as you pop one of them.
In the area with the balloons on the track, you will go through a tunnel. As soon as you come out the other side, you will see more balloons and the film roll in the middle.
After the previous collectible, you will go around a corner and then through some old buildings. Then you will go over two vert ramps almost one after the other. Remember to do any trick.
After the two vert ramps, you will use another jump and you will see the spray can in plain sight. Make sure you press L2+R2 to get down to it in time.
As soon as you finish the main objective of painting the old town, you will be back in the main city area and you will automatically go over another vert ramp.
Continue until you return to the original three signs that split the paths. This time go down the middle track, then jump to the rail on the right to get the piece of Castella.
After the previous collectible, stick left, and you will see the first cranes with wrecking balls. Honk at them with R3 to move them out of the way. After the first few, you will use the vert ramp.
After the previous ramp, continue forward until you smash through some glass and go through a building. Here, stick to the middle grind rail to find the spray can.

Soon after the previous spray can, you will finish the main objective about the crane and wrecking balls. After that, stay on the default track until you go around the left side corner. You will then see the piece of Castella on the right side.
After the previous collectible, you will go around a tight right corner. Immediately after the corner, jump to the grind rail on the right. This will take you to the final piece of Castella.

You will now have only one main objective left (the one about destroying four towers). Follow the pink signs until you get to the first tower. Just after the first tower, you will see the spray can in plain sight. You will have to jump to reach it.
As soon as you pick up the previous spray can, stick left and follow the green spray can sign. You will then see the can on the left side.
Self-explanatory. During a grind, use the right analog stick to perform tricks. Do this three times.
Below you on the very first jump. Press L2+R2 to get it.
Self-explanatory. Can be done at any point, but you get three easy corners in a row at the start after the previous collectible.

items.title: Perform 3 Perfect Drifts in a Row

spots.text: In plain sight on the right side after the first few corners.
Just after picking up the film roll, you will go around a corner to the right. Look out for the horn symbol in the middle of the screen and press R3.
In plain sight on the left side very soon after the previous dare.
You will use the vert ramp automatically soon after the previous spray can. Just do any trick while you jump it.

items.title: Trick on all the Vert Ramps

spots.text: Immediately after the previous one.

items.title: Trick on all the Vert Ramps

spots.text: Immediately after the previous one.

items.title: Trick on all the Vert Ramps

spots.text: Once you reach the part where you go under a temple, look out for the green sign on the left pointing you towards the spray can. Jump to the grind rail and follow this path to get the can.
You will use it automatically soon after the previous spray can.

items.title: Trick on all the Vert Ramps

spots.text: After the previous jump, stick to the right (follow the green sign), and you will then see the can in plain sight on the left side.

After the rainbow track section and coming back down to the normal tracks, you will see the finishing signs. Just before them, you will see a red onsen sign and a track going to your left. Take the left track to find the alternative finish.
Self-explanatory. Do not crash during the level.

levels.name: Takeo Onsen
levels.note: This level will only unlock if you found the onsen exit in level 1-6-1. These levels are more of a collectible in themselves than an actual level. Here you can just learn more about the world, lore and characters of the game.

spots.text: At the very start, stick to the left, and you will soon see the can in plain sight on the left-side track.
You will collect it almost automatically soon after the previous can.
Just after the previous ticket, you will grind on the wing of a green plane. Use the right analog stick during the grind to do a trick.

items.title: Trick on the Plane Wing Grind

spots.text: Found in the air after the next jump, soon after the wing grind.
In plain sight on the single track after the spray can, hard to miss.

In the hangar, stick to the left side to return to the start of the level. This time, go right. This will eventually bring you back around to the start again, but this time from the left side. Stay on the right track (without counting the rainbow one) to collect the airport ticket at the top of the jump.

Now you are back at the start; take the same path you took the first time (the left track). By this point, you should have had enough time to build up a combo and fill up the special bar on the right side of the screen. This will make special rainbow tracks appear. Just after the jump where you picked up the first spray can, stick to the right to see a new rainbow track. Take it to get the spray can.

Follow the track just like you did on your first time around, all the way until you are approaching the hangar again (where the second ticket was). Here you will now see a rainbow track on your left. Take it and go over the rooftops. Just as the tracks unite again, press R2 and jump to the right to get on the rainbow track. Then follow this track to get the spray can.

Once you return to the start with the super bar filled up, stick to the right side lower track and you will see a yellow sign telling you the film roll is to the right. Jump up to the rails, then look for another sign telling you the film roll is to your left. Here, you will see a rainbow track in front of you. Use the R2 button to jump to it and get the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Just build a chain of tricks, grinds and manuals until you get a combo of x10.
Self-explanatory. Easiest to do on some of the larger vert jumps.

items.title: Chain 3 Tricks in a Single Jump

spots.text: While in the air, press L2+R2 to air stomp down to the track. Just before landing, hold up or down on the left analog stick to land with a manual.

items.title: Land A Manual After an Air Stomp

spots.text: At the very start, stick left until you see it on the rail you can grind.
Will most likely come automatically. At the start of the level, you will see other trains on the track. Just hit five of them.

Once you trigger the cutscene and the boss fight starts, the boss will create pillars on the tracks that can hurt you. Just change tracks just before they hit you to trigger a risky dodge. Do this five times.
During the section where you have to evade the hand swipes from the boss, jump over them and do any trick three times.

items.title: Trick Over the Mecha's Hands 3 Times

spots.text: In plain sight on the left side of the track after the boss does her second set of hand swipe attacks.
Hard to miss. In plain sight during the section where you are grinding on the floating structures.
During the section where you are riding the boss's rocket punch, you will see stacks of barrels on ground level. Just look out for them and smash through them.
Finish the level without crashing.
On your right in plain sight soon after the start.
On your left after the next corner.
Obtained almost automatically at the highest point of the vert jump after the second billboard.
On your left after landing the vert jump, where the previous can was.
On your left soon after the previous billboard. The spray can is on this billboard. Just use the left analog stick to reach it.

After the previous spray can, you will ride up the left side of the bridge, then once you use the jump at the top, perform a finger heel 180 in the air by pressing up on the right analog stick and then rotating it clockwise until it reaches the bottom.

items.title: Finger Heel 180 Over the Broken Bridge

spots.text: On your right soon after wallriding along the road. From the first billboard, press R2 to jump to the next one on the left.
The final billboards are all grouped together soon after the previous ones. Just use R2 to jump from one to another.
After the final billboard, you will still see more billboards on the next straight. The spray can is on the large billboard on your left.

After the previous can, you will see a green sign on the right side pointing to a can. You will only see the right side rainbow track if you have filled the special meter. Follow the rainbow track to find the can.

After the previous spray can, follow the tracks and wallride on the sides to follow the natural path. Once the camera switches view and a billboard falls down behind you, press R3 to use the horn for the dare. You will also get the film roll automatically.
Self-explanatory.

items.title: Perform a Trick After Leaving a Wallride

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Chugoku Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: On the right side rail after the first corner. Stay on this rail until you get to the bridge.

items.title: Grind Both Rails on the Kintaikyo Bridge

spots.text: Just after the previous can, you will get to a bridge. Look out for the green sign pointing towards the can. Here, jump to the middle track that takes you up to a vert jump. After this, you will get the spray.
Once you return to the tracks on the bridge, jump to the rail on the right side.

items.title: Grind Both Rails on the Kintaikyo Bridge

spots.text: You can do this during any wallride by using the right analog stick to do tricks, just like when you are in the air. Soon after the previous collectible, you will get to a section where you wallride along a waterfall. This is a good place to get this out of the way.
Also in the section where you are wallriding the waterfalls.
After going through the forest section, you will go through a field of sunflowers. Here, press R3 and use your horn.
If you have the special bar filled up, you will see a rainbow track on the left side of the sunflower field. Take it to reach the spray.
On the billboard to your left, just after the giant ball starts chasing you.
Accumulate a combo of x15 or more by the end of the section where the ball is chasing you. Just use manuals to combo tricks together.

items.title: Escape the Trap With a Combo of at Least x15

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end without crashing.
After the first corner, stick to the right to find it after the first red signs. Also ride the wall on the right side and hit the booster on it.
At the second corner, press R2 and jump to the wall where you will find the spray can. Here, make sure you hit all five of the boost pads on the wall.
After the tunnel, you will go around a corner going left. After this, stick right to smash the dummy.
After dodging a large rock by passing it on its right-hand side, you will see the dummy at the end of the next straight, to the left of the red signs.
After the jump, go around the next right-hand corner, and then you will see the next wall with boosters as you approach the next corner.

As soon as you get to the next straight, look for a large billboard on your left. It has a booster and a spray can on it. From this board, quickly jump to the rainbow wall on the right with the other four boosters (must have the special bar filled). If you do not get time, do not worry, you can do a separate run just for the booster dare.
During the second lap, you should have charged up your special bar. After going through the first tunnel, jump to the rainbow railing on your right. This will take you through the shortcut tunnel.

As you approach the corner where you hit the third crash dummy on your first lap, you will see a rainbow rail on your right (if you have the special bar filled up). Use it to grind around the corner and collect the next spray can.
During the second lap, just after the jump where you got the previous can, stick to the left and jump over to the track that separates and goes through the cave. The can will be inside this cave.
On the final lap, once you get to the bridge with the cranes, you will see a rainbow rail on the right (if you have the special bar filled). Follow it to get the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Finish the race in 1st place.
Self-explanatory.

[Trick.](http://Trick.At) At the very start of the level, you will go over a jump and hit a rail switcher. Just do any advanced trick during this jump (you can see the list of advanced tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu).

items.title: Activate a Rail Switcher With an Advanced

spots.text: After the first few corners, you will see the three main signs pointing you in the direction of the main objectives. Here, jump to go straight past the signs and collect the spray can.

After the previous can, you will go over a vert jump, then over another jump. After that, continue forward by following the green sign into the tunnel. You will get the can just before the next vert jump.

Once you return to the start where the three signs are, follow the green ramen sign to the left, then follow it again by sticking to the right. Follow this path by delivering the ramen. After delivering the third ramen bowl, you will wallride on a wall to your left, then jump to one on your right, where you will find the spray can.

After delivering all the ramen, continue straight until you circle back around to the start of the level, where the three signs are. Go left again (where the ramen sign was), then at the next split, follow the blue sign to the left. On the next straight, dodge the red boards to hit the doll in the middle of the track.

After the previous collectible, you will then go around a corner while grinding on a yellow rail. Then, on the next straight, you will see two tracks. Stick to the one on the left (the one that ends on a vert jump). After the vert jump, you will collect the doll.

After the previous collectible, you will circle back around to the straight. At the end of it, follow the pink sign to the left. Follow this path until you grind on a boat, then air stomp to avoid crashing in the air. Straight after that, jump to the rightmost rail to get the spray can.

After clearing the bridge, you will circle back around to the start of the level, where the three signs are. This time, follow the right side path (blue sign). You will then wallride around a corner. At the end of this wallride, you can collect the final doll.

After the previous collectible, continue straight. You will then destroy the first work of art (main objective). After that, you will go around the corner to the right. As soon as you land the jump, get to the rail on your right to collect the film roll.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.

items.title: Score Over 1000 Points From Grind Sweet Spots

levels.name: Matsue Castle
levels.note: This level is another shop where you can spend your spray cans on new stickers needed for the Full Set trophy.

spots.text: Soon after the track splits into two paths (it doesn't matter which way you go), you will see the can on the wallride to your left.

On the next straight, jump up to the rail on your right, then hit the rail switcher while performing any advanced trick (look for the list in the Tricktionary in the pause menu). Then continue straight by following the now straight track into the cave, where you will find the spray can.

items.title: Activate 3 Rail Switches With Advanced Tricks

spots.text: As you make your way through the cave, you will have multiple more chances to hit rail switchers with advanced tricks.

items.title: Activate 3 Rail Switches With Advanced Tricks

spots.text: Follow the cave until you do another vert jump, then land back in the cave. Just after this jump, if you have your super meter full, you will see a rainbow track on your right with a spray can sign. Jump onto it and follow it to the end to get the can.
Just after the previous spray can, you will get to an area in the cave with water spouts coming from below with multiple grind rails. Here, stick to the right rail to get the spray can.
Just jump from one rail to another five times in the area with the water spouts (same place as you picked up the previous can).

items.title: Perform 5 Grind Transfers in the Burst Pipe Cave

spots.text: Immediately after the water spouts area, you will spiral up through a cave room with a massive drill ascending in the middle. Wait until the horn symbol appears in the center of the screen, then press R3.
In plain sight in the large tunnel where you have to dodge the drills coming toward you.
Self-explanatory. Just get more than 1000 points with tricks that you perform with the right analog stick while grinding.

items.title: Score Over 1000 Points From Grind Tricks

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Knock It Out Of The Park
levels.song: Knock it out of the Park

spots.text: From the start, every time you see an enemy, dodge or jump over it at the very last second to get Risky Dodges. You will have to do this 20 times before you reach the stadium.

items.title: Risky Dodge 20 Enemies Before Reaching the Stadium

spots.text: After the big jump close to the start of the level, you will land on a straight with a few enemy trains. Here, jump to the rail on your right where the spray can is.
After going through a tunnel where you have to dodge a lot of enemies, you will see a wallride on your right that follows the left hand corner. The film roll is on this wall.
Once you reach the stadium, the boss will start launching baseballs at you. You will then have to do a trick and return it to her. The three tricks linked to dares can be seen by pausing the game.

items.title: Hit a Baseball With a Back 720, Dare: Hit a Baseball With a Front Cancel Impossible
Hit a Baseball With a Finger Heel 360

spots.text: Once you get the boss down to about half HP, she will activate the third loop of the track. Soon after this, you will go downhill and see a rail on your left where the spray can is.
Self-explanatory. Do not crash during the entire level.

levels.name: Light, Fire Destruction!
levels.song: Abandoned Shimanami Road ~しまなみ廃道~

spots.text: After crossing the water close to the start, you will see a green spray can sign telling you to keep left. Just stay on the tracks and do not jump to continue straight. This will take you up to the bridge where the can is found.

After the previous collectible, continue until you have to air stomp to avoid a billboard. As soon as you land, look out for a grind rail on your right. Ride it, then use the vert jump to jump over the lighthouse.
Continue on this path and you will soon have to dodge some red signs under a bridge. After going around the next corner, get ready to jump with R2 to reach the gear above the temple.

Continue forward and you will eventually reach a bridge with lightning striking on it. Dodge three of them at the last moment to finish the dare. The gear can also be found on this bridge, close to the end on the right side.

items.title: Risky Dodge 3 Lightning Bolts on the Bridge

spots.text: Just after the bridge with lightning, you will see a track switch banner on the left. Hit it to get the tracks to switch left. This will take you to the can.

After the previous can, you will fall back down to a straight track. If you have your special meter filled, you will see a rainbow track on your left where the yellow film roll sign is. Ride this all the way to the end to finish the dare and collect the film roll.

Continue through the level until you reach another long bridge. Halfway across, the bridge will get destroyed and you will fall down below and cross over a boat. As soon as you do, the horn sign will appear in the center of the screen. When it does, press R3.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the start of the level, you will learn how to do tunnel loops by pressing L2 + a direction. You will then go through two tunnels. Perform a total of three full loops around the tunnels.
Found on the right side of the second tunnel.
Soon after the spray can, you will perform a vert jump and hit a switch that opens the pipe door below you. Perform a Front 540 Heel (pause the game to see the button combo) while hitting the switch.

items.title: Activate the Door Switch With a Front 540 Heel

spots.text: After you vert jump and hit the switch and fall into a large pipe that you can freely drive around, you will go around a corner inside and then see the gear on the side.

After you leave the large pipe, you will jump over a building. After that, watch out for a yellow sign with a film roll on it pointing you left. Here you will see a rainbow rail on your left if you have your special meter filled up. Jump to it and follow it to get the collectible. In the exact same place you collect the film roll you will see the horn sign appear in the middle of the screen. Press R3 to scare the seagulls.

items.title: Scare the Seagulls at the Docks

spots.text: On the side of the massive pipe you go through, with poison gas coming out of the pipes.

After you leave the massive pipe with poison gas, you will jump over a fallen building. As you jump, hold left to land on the left side track. This will take you to the spray can and the secret Onsen Exit.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Dogo Onsen
levels.note: This level will only unlock if you found the Onsen Exit at the end of level 3-1-2. Exhaust all the dialogue to collect the Onsen.

spots.text: At the start, follow the blue sign by going left. You will soon drive through the first torii gate.
As soon as you drive through the torii gate, jump to the rail on your left to get the box.
After the previous box of mandarins, keep following the rail until you see the next box in plain sight on the rail as you go past the side of a castle.
Soon after the previous box, you will go through a castle. After this, you will jump over a wall and see the next box in plain sight in front of you.

After the previous collectible, follow the tracks to circle back around to the start where the three main signs are. This time, go right and then go straight, following the blue and pink signs, to go through the torii gate.
Continue and you will go through a tunnel and see the three signs at the end again. Keep right and follow the blue sign. You will then go through another tunnel where the torii gate is.

Soon after the previous collectible, you will see another three signs. Here, jump to the wallride on the left to collect the box of mandarins, then stay on it and don't hit the switch to continue left.

After the previous collectible, do not hit the switch that changes the track direction, so you can keep following the blue signs. Eventually, you will jump down to a town below. This jump is a great place to finish the dare.

items.title: Chain 5 Tricks in a Single Jump

spots.text: Keep following this path until you blast through a theatre performance. Here, press R3 to use your horn and finish the dare.
After the first performance stage, you will continue through another tunnel. The gear will be on the right side of this tunnel.

After the three theatres, you will eventually circle all the way back to the start. Here, go right and then left. After the first passengers, go straight, not left, and you will then soon see the gear on the right side.

After the gear, keep following the yellow arrow at the top of the screen until you drop the second passenger off. After that, keep following the yellow arrow. This will take you to the third load of passengers. After this, you will jump up to a half pipe where you will find the spray can on the right side.

After delivering all six passengers, you will eventually circle all the way back to the start of the level where the three signs were. Here, go left and then DON'T follow the pink sign and go right. You will eventually go through a tunnel with a wall in the middle. The box can be found to the right of this wall.

After the previous box, you will circle back to the start once more. This time, go right where the three main signs were at the start. Then follow the pink signs until you jump to another town. As soon as you land, look out for the gear on your right.
After picking up the previous gear, you will be chasing another train. Get a x10 combo while you do this.

items.title: Reach a x10 Combo While Chasing the Botchan Ressha

spots.text: During the chase, you will get to an upper section where the tracks split. Here, stick to the right side to get the film roll.

levels.name: Shikoku Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: From the start of the level, follow any track. You will eventually have to hit a switch to get the tracks to continue straight. After that, you will have to air stomp to avoid hitting the seal billboard. After that, you will jump over a red sign. As soon as you do, quickly air stomp down through the glass as soon as you can to land where the spray can is. If you leave the air stomp too long, you will miss it.
Immediately after the previous collectible, you will enter an aquarium tunnel. Here, press R3 to use your horn.

items.title: Scare the Fish in the Aquarium

spots.text: After leaving the aquarium, you will go through a forest. During the section with the grind rails, use the right analog stick to perform any five tricks.

items.title: Perform 5 Grind Tricks While Grinding the Branches

spots.text: After the grind rail section in the forest, you will wallride a wall on your right. Quickly get to the upper part of this wall to collect the film roll.
After going through a tree trunk you can move freely around inside, you will get to another tree section. Here, stick to the right side to collect the gear.

Just after the previous gear, you will get to a section with two ridable walls, one on each side. Wait until they get close to each other, then keep pressing R2 to jump from one to another three times.
Just after the previous dare, you will ride a stream of water down a half-pipe-shaped trunk. At the start of this section, stick right to get the can.
During the section with the water slide, keep going up the sides as if it were a half pipe and perform three tricks in the air.

items.title: Perform 3 Aerial Tricks On the Stream Halfpipe

spots.text: During the water slide section, look out for a rainbow grind rail on the left side, only if you have the special meter filled up. Jump to it and follow it to get the gear.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the start, go straight and ride the right-hand wall to get to the higher track where the first toolbox is.
As soon as you pick up the previous toolbox, jump to continue straight and land in the half pipe below where the film roll can be found on the right side.
At the end of the halfpipe, where the film roll was, jump up and grind one of the rails on either side.

items.title: Grind Both Sides of the Tunnel Halfpipe

spots.text: After grinding the rail out of the half pipe, you will do two jumps on the next straight. After that, you will see a grind rail on the left and a track on the right. This time, stick left and follow the rail to pick up a toolbox.
Almost immediately after the toolbox, you will go around a corner and see the gear on the rail to the right.

After the previous gear, follow the tracks and eventually you will circle back to the start. This time, continue straight without using the wallrides to return to the half pipe where the film roll was. This time, grind the other side rail at the end of the half pipe.

items.title: Grind Both Sides of the Tunnel Halfpipe

spots.text: Just like last time, after the grind rail leaves the halfpipe, you will return to the area where the path splits into a rail going left and the track going right. This time, follow the track right to collect another toolbox.

After the previous toolbox, you will perform a large jump. If you have the special meter filled up, you will see a rainbow track on your right. Take this track and you will go through a rainbow tunnel. Do a full loop inside it to finish the dare.
Immediately after the rainbow tunnel.

After you land from the previous can, stick to the rail on the left like you did before to circle back around to the start. Here, follow the track right, following the blue gear sign. On the next straight, stay on the tracks at the bottom. This will take you to a vert ramp where you will get the gear and is a good spot to complete the dare.

items.title: Finger Kick 540 on a Vert Ramp

spots.text: Continue on the tracks and you will eventually circle back around to the start. Go right again, but this time wallride the wall on your left. Then stick to the rail on the left and follow the spray can sign. At the end of the next straight of the rail, where the second green sign is, you will see a rainbow rail in front of you. Jump to it and follow it to get the spray can.
Self-explanatory. Obtain a 20 trick combo by chaining tricks with manuals and grinds.

levels.name: Kochi Castle
levels.note: This is a shop level. Here you will be able to spend your spray cans on more stickers needed to work towards the Full Set trophy. In this shop you will also be able to purchase your first five trains with the gears you have collected, to work towards the True Densha Collector trophy.

spots.text: On the platform to the right after the first corner.
When going through the dark forest with the ghost in front of you, you will get to a large see-through wallride. Just use the right analog stick on it to perform a trick.
Follow the track until it goes through a little pond of water. After this, you will get to a straight with multiple tracks. Jump to the one on the left to get the gear.

At the end of the straight where the previous gear was, you will perform a large jump. During this jump, perform three intermediate or higher tricks. You can see the list of intermediate tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.

items.title: Chain 3 Intermediate (or Higher) Tricks at the Torii Jump

spots.text: After the large jump, you will enter a tunnel you can loop around. The gear will be on the left side.

After the tunnel where the previous gear was, you will reach an area with water and black enemies. You will eventually get to a boat with a yellow sign with a film roll on it. Here, if you have the special bar filled, you will see a rainbow rail on the left. Jump to it to get to the rainbow halfpipe where you must perform one trick.

items.title: Trick in the Rainbow Tunnel Halfpipe

spots.text: After the previously mentioned rainbow half pipe, continue on the rainbow tracks to get to the film roll.
Just after the film roll, you will enter a red tunnel with fireballs moving around it. In this tunnel, do a full loop.
Also in the fiery tunnel on the right side wall.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the start, stick to the right to follow the track down past the spray can sign. You will see the can in plain sight.
After the spray can you will go through a tunnel. Hit the two boosters inside.

items.title: Hit all the Boosters in the Tunnels

spots.text: Continue until you go over a giant spinning record. The vinyl record is on top of it.
Almost immediately after the previous collectible, you will cross over another record with a vinyl on it.
After the second giant disc, jump to the yellow grind rail on the right to go over the jukebox and collect the spray can.
As soon as you land on the other side of the jukebox, you will cross over a third record with a vinyl on it.
On the right side of the track, just before the Start/Finish line.
At the start of the second lap, stick left and then go through the tunnel. Inside, hit the two boosters.

items.title: Hit all the Boosters in the Tunnels

spots.text: As soon as you exit the tunnel, jump up to the grind rail on your right. If you have your special meter filled, this will take you to a rainbow rail where the gear is found at the end.
Once you get to the third giant disc again, if you have your special meter filled, you will see rainbow tracks on your right. Follow them to get the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Finish a lap in under 60 seconds.
Self-explanatory. Finish the race in 1st.
On the right side rail at the start of the level.
After dodging the massive 8 balls while wallriding, you will get to a wide slope with five tracks on it leading up to the boss. The film roll will be on the left side track.
At the top of the slope, you will face the boss. He will start by using slam attacks that blast out rings of fire. Dodge five of these attacks at the last possible moment.

items.title: Risky Dodge the Slam Attack 5 Times

spots.text: After charging your special bar, you will follow the rails into the boss's cannon. Inside, you will cross over the top of two fans. When doing this, press R3 to blow your horn.

items.title: Speed Up 3 Big Fans Inside The Rocker

spots.text: After the second large fan inside the boss, you will reach a section with presses trying to crush you from above. In this section, stick to the right to get the gear.
After the previous collectible, you will hit a switch to open the door to a tunnel. Inside the tunnel, just go around it to do a full loop.

items.title: Perform a Tunnel Loop Inside The Rocker

spots.text: Soon after leaving the tunnel, you will go over a vert jump and head down a vertical wall towards a third giant fan. Press R3 to blow your horn just before you reach it.

items.title: Speed Up 3 Big Fans Inside The Rocker

spots.text: Once you get back outside, you will be in a long half pipe with water in it. Just do 10 tricks off the side of it.

items.title: Perform 10 Aerial Tricks on the Moat Halfpipe

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.
After the first two underwater sections, you will go over a vert jump. After this, you will grind around the back of a lighthouse. When doing this, press R3 to use your horn.

items.title: Scare the Seagulls at the Lighthouse

spots.text: Soon after the lighthouse, you will grind on the side of a large ship. Jump to reach the can.
In plain sight during the next underwater section.

In the next underwater section, you will bounce off a jellyfish and then have to air stomp to bounce off another jellyfish. After the second bounce, ride the short track and then at the end, air stomp as soon as you can to drop down to the collectible in time.

Soon after the previous collectible, you will see a sign on your left with a spray can on it telling you to go left. If you have your special meter filled up, you will see a rainbow track on your left. Jump to it and follow it to the spray can. Just watch out for the large fish.
You will soon get to a section with swordfish jumping out of the water. Land on one to grind it. During the grind, do any trick with the right analog stick.

items.title: Grind Trick on a Fish Nose

spots.text: During the section where you get caught by a shark and control it, you will see vases. Just swim through five of them.

After the first five or six vases during the shark section, make sure you stick left and do not hit the metal bars, which will take you to the normal exit. You will then see the gear in plain sight next to the large mines. This path will also take you to the Onsen Exit.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Yubara Onsen
levels.note: This level will only be available if you found the Onsen Exit in level 4-1-1. Exhaust the dialogue and leave.

spots.text: From the start, head straight towards the first fork in the tracks where the signs are. First, head right and then go straight by sticking to the right again. This will take you to the first peach.
After the first peach, stick right to go around the corner on the tracks. This will take you through the torii gate.
Immediately after the torii gate, land on the rail to the right where the peach is.
As soon as you get to the end of the yellow rail that you landed on to get the previous peach, jump left to go through the torii gate.

After the Torii gate, stick to the right to continue straight. You will then get to another fork with all three main signs. Take the right path and follow the green sign. Then follow the green sign again by going straight. This will start the Slalom main objective. During this section, get 5000 points.

items.title: Score 5000 Points During the Slalom Run

spots.text: Close to the start of the Slalom course, you will enter a cave. In this cave, you will see the can on your left.
During the Slalom course, you will go through a rocky halfpipe section. You will see the gear in plain sight as you leave the first halfpipe.
After the Slalom course, you will go under a temple and then see the peach on a wall you can wallride on your right.
Continue until you circle back around to the second torii gate. This time, stick to the left and follow the pink sign. You will soon get to a wallride where the film roll is found.

After the film roll, you will return to the start of the level where the second fork is. This time, stick left and follow the pink sign. This will start the second main objective where you have to crash into the other trains. After the first vert jump, stick left to take the upper path where you will find the gear.
After the previous gear, continue on this path, and you will see this gear in plain sight as you cross a small bridge.

After the second main objective, you will eventually circle back around to where the second torii gate is. Here, continue straight and then at the next fork, take the left path. Then continue straight by sticking left to take the vert jump into a tube. At the end, you will see the peach on the wall to your left.
You will go through it after the previous collectible.
In plain sight after the torii gate.

After the previous collectible, you will eventually circle back to the start. At the first fork, take the left path to quickly get back to the area with the second torii gate. Here, go straight and then simply follow the blue signs to get to the area behind the waterfall. Here you will grind a yellow rail. Use the right analog stick to perform any five tricks.

items.title: Perform 5 Grind Tricks Behind The Waterfall

spots.text: Self-explanatory.
At the end of the first straight, on the wall to the left.
Soon after the first can, you will go through a half pipe and then around a corner, then up a small slope. At the top, jump onto the rail straight ahead to get to the can.
Self-explanatory. Fill the energy bar before doing a full lap of the first floor. You will eventually have to fill it anyway to ride the rainbow rail up to the second floor.

items.title: Fill the Energy Bar Before Completing a 1st Floor Lap

spots.text: In plain sight above you once you get to the tunnel on the second floor.
Soon after the previous collectible, you will get to a straight with seven tracks, with the ones on the sides being at a slight angle. Stick to the right here to get the can.
Found on the third floor. You will see it in plain sight on the straight after going through the tunnel section.
Self-explanatory.

items.title: Reach 1st Place in Under 1:00 on the 3rd Floor

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Hit 25 rivals in total.
Self-explanatory. You can easily do this on any of the rainbow rails between floors.

items.title: Score Over 250 Points on a Single Grind

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Reach the end of the level without crashing.

At the start of the level, you will have to return baseballs just like with the boss at the end of chapter 2. Do this with any hardcore trick. You can check the list of tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.

items.title: Hit a Baseball With a Hardcore Trick

spots.text: After deflecting the first few baseballs, the camera will change and you will have to jump over the sandworm a few times. Just jump at the very last second to get a Risky Dodge.

After deflecting the second load of baseballs, you will go through a destroyed city. You will eventually get to a section where you have to chain together multiple wallrides by jumping from one wall to another. The gear will be on one of the left side walls in plain sight.

Continue through the level and eventually you will have to use an air stomp to move out of the way of the boss. After that, you will wallride around a long corner and then see the gear above a structure on the next straight.
After the encounter with the boss in the tunnel, you will come out to a half pipe where you can keep going back and forth with the boss. The film is on the side of this halfpipe.
In the same area as the film roll, you will go back and forth with the boss. Use the rails on the sides of the half pipe to jump to the rails on the boss. Grind on both sides to finish the dare.

items.title: Grind Both Sides of the Worm During the Joust

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Just perform any five tricks with the right analog stick while wallriding any wall throughout the level.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
Close to the start of the level, you will hang from a monorail. During this section, dodge the billboards at the very last moment.

items.title: Perform 5 Risky Dodges While Riding the Monorail

spots.text: After letting go of the first monorail, you will go under an electric pylon and then wallride a wall on your right. The gear is on this wall.
After letting go of the second monorail, jump over the arrow sign to continue straight into the tunnel. Inside, do a full loop around it.
After leaving the tunnel, you will soon ride the monorail down to a body of water. Here, swing left to reach the gear on the side.
After the body of water, swing to the monorail on the right and then onto the ridable wall where the spray can is.

Dare: Perform 5 Risky Dodges While Riding the Monorail (4-5/5). After the previous collectible, you will ride a monorail over some blimps that you have to dodge. When going by them, press R3 to use your horn. Make sure you get risky dodges to finish the other dare.

items.title: Blow the Blimps Off Course and

spots.text: After the blimps, you will reach a section with a monorail that goes over a bridge with rails on the sides. Here, jump to the right and look for a sign with a film roll on it pointing that way. If you have your special bar filled, a rainbow rail will appear off to that side. Swing onto it and follow the rainbow rails to collect all three things.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Kinosaki Onsen
levels.note: This level will only be available if you found the Onsen Exit in level 5-1-1. Exhaust the dialogue and leave.

levels.name: Himeji Castle
levels.note: This is a shop level. Here you will be able to spend your spray cans on more stickers needed to work towards the Full Set trophy. In this shop you will also be able to purchase another 5 trains with the gears you have collected, to work towards the True Densha Collector trophy.

levels.name: Into Tarantula Territory
levels.artist: Tee Lopes, Ryo Nagamatsu, & Jonny Atma

spots.text: After the first vert jump, you will land in a pipe. Stick to the right side to get the can.
After going through a building, you will ride a monorail. Here, jump to the right side to get the can.

Continue until you go through a village with water going through the middle. Here, watch out for a blue sign telling you there is a gear to the right. Jump up to the right and then up to the wallride to get the gear.

Once you get to the large city, you will see a sign telling you there is a gear on your left. Just after this sign, hit the track switch banner on your left to get the tracks to change direction. Now just follow them to get to the gear.
Follow the path through the destroyed city until you see this film roll on a large wall you can wallride on your right, immediately after a left side wallride.

Soon after the previous collectible, you will see another track switcher. To reach it, use the wallride on your left. Activate it and the tracks will take you above the stadium. When going over it, press R3 to use your horn.

If you took the path above the stadium to get the previous dare, you will take an alternative route through the rest of the level. After crossing some broken bridges, you will get to a section with loads of ships. Here, if you have your special meter filled, you will see a rainbow rail on your right. Follow it to see a large building come down. You will dodge it automatically as long as you do not brake.
If you took the path above the stadium, you will eventually reach the secret exit.
Self-explanatory. Get 3000 or more points with monorail tricks. While riding a monorail, swing to the sides and use the right analog stick to do tricks.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
From the start, head forward until you see the signs at the main crossroad. Here, continue straight to see the cup of tea above you.
Continue straight after the previous cup and eventually you will find this one after landing a vert jump.

After the previous cup, follow the green sign by heading straight down into the underground. You will see the cup on the left side of the tunnel. Make sure you also use 5 boosters in this tunnel for the other dare.

items.title: Hit 5 Boosters in the Metro Tunnels

spots.text: After the tunnel, you will circle back around to the start. This time, go right and then at the next set of signs, head right again. This will take you to a vert jump where you will find the cup.
Soon after the previous cup, you will see more signs. Go right, and you will attach to a monorail. When leaving the monorail, press L2+R2 to land with an air stomp.

items.title: Land an Air Stomp After Detaching From a Monorail

spots.text: Once you reach the area where you are on tracks over a river, stick to the rails on the right, then air stomp before you hit the bridge to get the final cup. Make sure you leave the river with a x10 combo.

items.title: Exit the River With a x10 Combo

spots.text: Continue on the tracks above water. Then at the end, stick right and follow the green sign. Once you get to the monorail, swing right to get the gear.
Continue on this path and you will eventually get to a dirt half pipe. The gear will be on the left side of it.

After finishing the main objective in the area where the previous collectibles were, you will return to the city. At the first signs, go left, then left again at the second signs, then right and right again, following the brown signs. This will take you to the gear.

After finishing the brown main objective, you will once again return to the city. This time, follow the blue signs, right and then left. You will then eventually light the fires on the mountain for the main objective. As soon as you do this, the horn sign will appear in the center of the screen. When it does, press R3.

items.title: Startle the Bears in the Bamboo Forest

spots.text: As you return to the city after the blue main objective, you will go through another tunnel with more boosters if you need them for the dare. You will also see the spray can in plain sight.
Once you return to the main crossing in the city, this time follow the pink signs to get to the main objective. Just after lighting the fires on the mountain, you will see the film roll.
From the start, go forward and into the half pipe. Continue straight through the tunnel and you will eventually get to a wallride with the spray can on it.

After the previous spray can, stick to the left wallride and fall onto the rail. Then continue and take the vert jump in front of you. After landing, jump to the rail on your right. This will take you through the top part of the stadium. As soon as the horn sign appears in the center of the screen, press R3.
In the upper part of the stadium, stick right and take the vert jump. You will collect the ball as soon as you land.
After the previous ball, you will hang from a monorail where the spray can is found.
After landing from the monorail, you will be in a half pipe. Go to the end and use the ramp to land on a rail with a ball at the end.
After the next vert jump, stay on the tracks and take the rail to the film roll.

After the film roll, continue on this path until you ride one of three yellow grind rails that all then become one. After that, you will ride a short monorail around a corner. As soon as you land, hop over to the double tracks on your left below that take you to the wallride that goes around the corner. The ball will be on this wallride.

After the previous ball, you will go through the stadium. Once you come out the other side, look out for rainbow tracks on your left (you must have the special bar filled). Use them to get to the gear.

From the previous gear, continue and you will end up on the same monorail after the three yellow grind rails like last time. This time, once you drop off the monorail, stick to the right and ride the yellow rail. This will take you back to the area just after where you collected the first spray can. As soon as you land, jump to the wallride on your left and then ride the rail to the triple tracks with the vert jump at the end. After landing the vert jump, look for a rainbow rail on your left. Ride it to get to the rainbow tunnel where you must loop around it once.
At the end of the Rainbow Tunnel.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory. Use the right analog stick to perform tricks while wallriding.
Close to the start, you will grind on the side of two trains. Just do any trick with the right analog stick while you ride each one.

items.title: Trick While Grinding on Each Train

spots.text: Just after the two trains you grind on, you will go through a tunnel. In this tunnel, you will see the gear on your right.
In the next section and throughout the level, you will see yellow spiderwebs that you can bounce on. Air stomp five of them with R2+L2.
During the section where the ferris wheel is chasing you, you will be in a halfpipe. Look for the gear on the right side.

After going underwater in the moat, you will use a vert jump to exit the water. As soon as you land, the camera will change to a side view as you go past a castle. Watch out for the horn sign in the center of the screen. Press R3 once it does.

items.title: Wake the Occupying Forces in the Castle

spots.text: In the underground area where you have to dodge the oncoming trains, you will see it on your left after the first train.
Soon after the spider webs in the water, you will see it in plain sight as you ride the yellow rails.
Just after the previous gear, you will see a rainbow track on your right side if you have your special bar filled up. Follow it to get to the film roll.
Close to the end of the level, you will chase some enemies up a tall tower and then descend back down in the air. While falling, perform five tricks.

items.title: Chain 5 Tricks on the Haru Skyscraper Descent

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Kansai Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: Through the level, you will see green circles of wind. You activate these by doing tricks. You will have to activate at least one with an intermediate trick, an Advanced Trick and a hardcore trick. You can check the trick list in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.

items.title: Activate a Yukaze with an Intermediate Trick, Dare: Activate a Yukaze with an Advanced Trick
Activate a Yukaze with a Hardcore Trick

spots.text: Once you get to the forest, you will see a blue gear sign below a Yukaze (wind circle). Do not do a trick and instead perform an air stomp to go down to the gear.
Soon after the gear, you will go around a right-side corner and then see a wallride on your left. The film roll will be on this wall.
After the forest, you will jump over a temple and land in a cave. The gear will be in plain sight in this cave.

After leaving the cave, you will ride a monorail. As soon as you get off it, look for a rainbow track on your left next to a spray can sign (you will need the special meter filled up). As soon as you get on the rainbow tracks, you will circle around a pagoda. Press R3 to use your horn. After that, you will get the spray can before going through a waterfall.

items.title: Scare The Crows at the Pagoda

spots.text: After climbing a mountain by using spiderwebs, you will descend to the city again. Here, watch out for a spiderweb below you with a gear on it as soon as you take a jump. Perform an air stomp to go down and get the gear.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
After the second corner, you will jump onto three tracks. First, stick right and then left to smash the crates.
Continue until you go underwater. Here, look out for another track on your right. As soon as you see it, jump to it. On this track you will smash a crate and get the film roll.
Keep advancing through the dark level until you see three walls on your right. Wallride them to find the collectible on the second wall.
After the walls, you will land on three tracks. As soon as you do, stick to the right to smash the box.
After the crate, you will take a jump and see a track switch banner. Make sure you activate it by doing a trick. This will get the tracks to go left, where you will get the can.
After the spray can, you will enter a tunnel. In this tunnel, you will have multiple extra crates to smash to finish the dare.
After you leave the tunnel, you will finally be out of the dark and in the air. During this long airtime is the best time to get this dare done.

items.title: Chain 10 Tricks in a Single Jump

spots.text: On your left during the long airtime after the tunnel.

After the long airtime section, you will smash through some glass to go through a building and enter a second building. As soon as you enter the second one, stick left and use the rainbow rail (must have special bar filled). Follow it to get the spray can.
After the previous can, you will land in the water. As soon as you do, look out for the horn sign in the center of the screen and press R3.

items.title: Make the Oysters Reveal their Pearls

spots.text: During the level, you will use a LOT of Yukaze (the wind circles). Just do three tricks at the perfect time when activating them.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
On the first straight above the red arrows.
Take the left path at the start and then ride the left side wall to get the flag.

After the previous checkered flag, continue around the corner to the left. You'll come across a spiderweb with a spray can floating above it. Jump toward it and air stomp down to collect the spray can.
On the next straight, use the ramp next to the gear sign to launch yourself toward the Yukaze, then continue on to the gear.
Continue through the level without using any rainbow tracks or rails. Eventually, you'll spot this gear sitting above a bridge on a straight, in plain sight.
On the wallride directly after the previous gear, you'll find the next collectible.

At the start of the second lap (or third, if you need more time to fill up your special bar), jump straight ahead at the first split in the tracks and use the rainbow Yukaze. After the first two monorails, look out for the horn sign in the middle of the screen and press R3.

items.title: Make People Scream on the Theme Park Rides

spots.text: You will get it straight after the previous dare.

Continue through the lap until you hit the big vert jump. Just after this, you'll jump over a spiderweb with a rainbow monorail above it (if your special bar is full). As you jump over the spiderweb, use an air stomp to bounce off it and up onto the monorail, where you'll grab the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Finish the race in 1st.
Self-explanatory. Finish a lap in 50s or less.
Self-explanatory. Just dodge rivals and obstacles at the last moment five times during a single lap.

items.title: Perform 5 Risky Dodges on One Lap Without Crashing

spots.text: Play through the first section of the level, dodging the spotlights, until you reach a large halfpipe. Here, perform three tricks off the sides without getting spotted by the spotlights.

items.title: Perform 3 Tricks off the Halfpipe without Being Seen

spots.text: On the right side of the halfpipe.

Continue through the level a little more, and you'll eventually see a spray can sign pointing to the right just before the tracks split. Follow the track to the right and use the Yukaze to reach the spray can.

Soon after the previous spray can, you'll use some Yukaze to jump over a few spotlights. Then you'll grind along some rails on the rooftops, where you'll spot the spray can in plain sight between the rails.
After the previous collectible, you'll soon pass through a tunnel with spotlights on the sides. Just hit the base of the spotlights to destroy them.
In plain sight, just before you leave the tunnel with the spotlights.

During the next section you'll be able to destroy way more than the required five remaining spotlights. You'll find a few as you ride the monorail through the building, then another four or five along a grind rail that are hard to miss.
After you have to air stomp to avoid the stack of barrels, look out for rainbow tracks on your right. Take them and use the Yukaze to reach the film roll.
Immediately after the film roll, you'll ride a blimp. Just score points by doing tricks during the bounces.

items.title: Score 3000 Points by Chaining Tricks on the Blimp

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Score 5000 or more points while riding the monorails throughout the level. Swing, then use the right analog stick to do tricks.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
Self-explanatory. Derail 30 of the 100 trains within the first minute.
During the first section of the level, you'll have to derail 100 trains. Some of them will have red armor on their front but not on top. Destroy five of these trains by using an air stomp.
You will see it in plain sight as you go through a Yukaze during the first phase. Hard to miss.

After the short cutscene where the boss throws you up into the air, the second phase begins. Here, the enemy fires fireballs at the track, leaving fire behind. Jump over them at the very last second three times.
After using the first vert jump during the second phase, you'll see the gear on your right on the next straight.

After riding the rainbow rails and destroying the bridge, you'll move into the third phase of the boss. Here, the boss launches spiderweb-looking attacks at you that you have to jump through the middle of. Do a trick five times while doing so.

items.title: Trick Through Yamagata's Ring Attack 5 Times

spots.text: During the third phase, you'll reach a point where you go through a tunnel and have to dodge the boss's drifts. Here, you'll see the film roll in plain sight on the left side of the tunnel.
Self-explanatory. Defeat the boss without crashing.
At the first split in the tracks, take the left track to find the spray can on the next wallride.
Self-explanatory. Rack up a x20 trick chain before the first gate.

items.title: Have at Least a x20 Combo at the First Gate

spots.text: Once you reach the two green signs pointing you to the second gate switches, jump up to the rail on the left. Then continue until you reach a halfpipe. Follow it to find the gear on the left side.
Once you circle back around to the area with the green signs, this time keep right to find the gear on the left side of the tunnel you go into.
Self-explanatory. Go through the second gate after activating the two green switches in under three minutes.

items.title: Enter the Second Gate in Under 03:00

spots.text: Once you go through the second gate and reach the pink signs pointing to the next switches, stick to the right and you'll pick up the film roll on the next monorail.

After activating the two pink switches, you'll go down a straight with a massive statue of Molty the Mole in front of you. Just as you approach it, you'll see the horn sign appear in the middle of the screen. Press R3 to shatter the glass.

items.title: Rain Shattered Glass All Over the Molty Statue

spots.text: After going over the Molty statue, you'll go over a jump and see the spray can below you. Air stomp to make sure you get down to it in time.
Soon after the previous collectible, you'll enter a tunnel where you have to dodge trains coming toward you. Dodge ten of them at the very last moment.

items.title: Perform 10 Risky Dodges During the Trench Run

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Marouka Castle
levels.note: This is another shop level. More trains and stickers will become available.

spots.text: After the first Yukaze, you'll see a blue sign pointing left to a gear. Jump to the rail on your left and you'll soon see the gear.
Continue on this path past a few more Yukaze, and soon you'll have to go through two red arrow signs by sticking to the middle. Here, you'll pick up the spray can.

As you approach the city, you'll see two Yukaze (one on each side). Use either one to reach the next Yukaze with a rainbow monorail above it (you must have your special bar filled up). This will take you to the gear.
Continue through the level until you reach the part where the camera changes and a train chases you. This train will start firing missiles at you. Dodge five of them at the last moment.

Immediately after the chase scene with the missiles, you'll ride a long wall. At a certain point on this wall, the path gets narrow. Use the analog stick to perform any tricks as you go through the narrow section.
In the middle of the tracks in plain sight soon after the wallride.

In the city you'll reach a section where you have to dodge more police trains. Here, you'll use a vert jump off a triple track. Perform any hardcore trick during this jump. You can see the list of hardcore tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.

items.title: Perform a Hardcore Trick on a Vert Transfer on the City

spots.text: Found on the wallride on your left as soon as you land the previous vert jump.
Self-explanatory. Activate three Yukaze (wind currents) by doing advanced tricks. You can find the list of advanced tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the end of the halfpipe, just before the water section.
After jumping over a small dam, you'll see a yellow sign with a film roll on it pointing right. Follow it to get the film roll.
Continue through the level until you reach a halfpipe with water in it. Here, look out for the gear on the rideable wall on the right side.
After dodging a billboard with an air stomp, you'll reach a section with three monorails and some Yukaze. Stick to the right side monorail when possible to get the spray can.
Soon after the previous collectible, you'll cross atop some roofs. After that, look out for the horn sign in the middle of the screen and press R3.

At the end of the next bridge, you'll see a blue sign with a gear on it on the left side. If you have your special bar filled up, you'll see a rainbow track continuing straight. Use it to get to the gear.
Self-explanatory. Activate a Yukaze (wind current) at the perfect moment with any advanced trick.

items.title: Perform a Perfect Yukaze with an Advanced Trick

spots.text: Simply perform 30 tricks on wallrides, monorails or grinds.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory. Do not crash during the level.
After the first wallride, jump to continue forward to where the film roll sign is pointing to get it.
After the previous collectible, you'll smash through some glass into a building. Once inside, use the wallride on the left and activate the Yukaze to jump up behind the wallride.
After the spray can, look for a glass window you can smash through on your right. Follow the rail on the other side to get the gear on the wallride.

After the previous gear, you'll drop down onto the yellow rail that goes down to the right toward the fountain. While jumping the fountain, perform the hardcore trick. You can check the button combo in the pause menu.

items.title: Do a Front Cancel Kick Impossible Over the Fountain

spots.text: Immediately after you land the jump over the fountain.
After the previous collectible, you'll go past the cinema. Just after it, stick to the left track, and on the next straight, you'll see a digger with its bucket up. Grind on it.

items.title: Grind Trick on the Digger's Bucket

spots.text: Immediately after the digger.

After the spray can, stick to the right-side track to do the vert jump to the right, which will circle you back around to the very start. This time, just before you wallride the "coming soon" billboard, air stomp down to the action figure.

Continue through the building again and past the cinema. Again, stick to the left side track, and as soon as you're outside, change to the left track to take the vert jump. You'll collect the action figure once you land on the other side.

Immediately after the previous figure, jump to the rainbow tracks on your right (you must have the special bar filled up). Then follow this path until you see the yellow tunnel in front of you. Go down it to find the gear inside.

After the previous gear, you'll circle back around to the cinema again. Just past the cinema, switch to the middle track (the one that goes right). Then, at the top of the stairs, you'll jump onto a monorail. As soon as you do, drop off it with an air stomp to get to the rail below. This will take you through the cinema, where the horn sign will appear in the middle of the screen. Press R3.
Self-explanatory.
At the first set of signs where the tracks split, jump to continue forward. Then, at the next signs, jump again to continue straight to collect the figure.
After the previous figure, you'll go over two jumps. During the second jump, you'll see a figure below you. Air stomp down to it.
After the previous figure, you'll land on a straight. Here, jump up to the rail on your right, and you'll see the next figure on the wallride.

After the previous figure, you'll circle back around to the start. Go straight again at the first set of signs, then left at the next set of signs. Keep straight and follow the pink sign. After the monorail, and throughout the next section, you'll see jump pads. Air stomp on five of them to finish the dare.
After the first few bounce pads, you'll see two Yukaze next to each other. The spray can will be in the left one.

Soon after the spray can, you'll cut a rope hanging from a blimp (main objective). The film roll will be on the right side once you land. This section is also really good to get the chain of 5 tricks in the air thanks to the Yukaze.

items.title: Chain 5 Tricks in a Single Jump

spots.text: After circling back to the start again, take the right path (green sign), then stick right again to continue straight. This will take you through the tunnel where the figure is found.

Once you circle back around to the start, go right again and then left (follow the green signs). Once you reach the ball you jump over, air stomp it to start riding the rocket. Here, smash four of the green cubes.
In plain sight during the rocket ride.
Once you circle back to the start, follow the blue sign left and then stick right to get the figure on the wallride in front of you.
Circle back around to the start, and this time follow the blue sign by going left and then left again. You'll eventually get to an underwater area where you'll see the gear in plain sight.
Soon after the previous collectible, you'll go through a tunnel with fans. Just loop around it once.

items.title: Loop One of the Fan Tunnels

spots.text: On the left side of the fan tunnel.

levels.name: Chubu Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: At the first split in the tracks, take the right path, and you'll see the cache in plain sight.
Soon after the previous cache smash through the glass with an air stomp to get the collectible.
Soon after the previous cache, you'll get to two large tunnels. Take the right one first and collect the cache inside.
After coming out the other side of the sewers area, you'll see the film roll in plain sight above a Yukaze.
Once you get back around to the start/finish line and begin the second lap, this time take the left path at the start. You'll soon see the spray can above a Yukaze you can use to reach it.
Once you circle back around to the tunnels, this time go through the left one. The gear will be inside.
Once you reach the final lap, you should have your special bar filled up. At the start of the lap, go straight ahead at the first split and jump to the rainbow rail. This will take you to the gear.
On the final lap, you'll come out of the sewers automatically on a different path. As soon as you do, you'll see the gear above a windmill in front of you.
Self-explanatory. Finish the Race in 1st.
Self-explanatory. Finish a lap in under 65 seconds.
Self-explanatory. Hit 10 other trains.
On the left side of the first tunnel you go through.
Soon after the previous can, you'll use your horn to open some barriers and then jump into the cave. During this jump, do three tricks.

items.title: Chain 3 Tricks While Jumping into the Cave

spots.text: After dodging the first two trains in the cave, stick to the middle tracks, and you'll find the gear on the next wallride.
In the next tunnel you go through you will see purple stones. Smash 5 of them.
Once you reach the lava cave, you'll see waves of lava coming toward you that you have to jump over. Do tricks while doing this five times.
After the lava section, you'll enter a tunnel with loads of tracks. The spray can can be found on the right side of this tunnel.
Once you reach the ice section, turn with the left analog stick and press L2.
During one of the jumps in the ice section, you'll see the air stomp icon appear in the middle of the screen as you go over a hole. Air stomp to get the collectible.

Soon after exiting the ice cave, you'll enter a city. Close to the start of this area, you'll see a rainbow track on your right if you have your special bar filled up. Take it, and eventually you'll get to the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
Close to the start of the level, you'll start seeing snowmen. Throughout this section, hit ten of them.
Just after you start seeing snowmen you will go over a jump. As soon as you land, stick to the right to see the gear.

Just after the previous gear, you'll see a sign pointing right to a spray can. Stick right of this rock, ride the wallride, and then use the jump in the middle. Once you're in the air, perform an air stomp to break the ice and go underwater, where you'll get the collectible.
Once you get to the city area, you'll see three paths. Stick to the leftmost path to find the gear as you smash through some glass.

After smashing through a few glass windows, continue sticking to the left, and eventually you'll see a rainbow rail if you have your special bar filled up. This will take you to the data center. As you enter it, you'll see the horn sign in the middle of the screen. Press R3.
Found on your way out the other side of the data centre.
After finishing the level, start another run. Then, once you reach the jump after the first few snowmen, go to the rail on the far left and keep to the left to eventually find the gear.
