On your second run, once you reach the city, stick to the far right at all times. This will eventually take you to the Onsen exit.
Just use the right analog stick at any point you are on snow 20 times.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Matsumoto Castle
levels.note: Shop level. A few new Trains and Stickers available to purchase.

levels.name: Yamanouchi Onsen
levels.note: This level will only unlock if you found the Onsen Exit at the end of level 6-7-1. Exhaust all the dialogue to collect the Onsen.

spots.text: Stick left just after the first two wallrides.
The first vert ramp will be immediately after the gear. Just perform any advanced trick.

items.title: Perform 3 Advanced Tricks on Vert Ramps

spots.text: Soon after the first vert ramp. Just perform any advanced trick.

items.title: Perform 3 Advanced Tricks on Vert Ramps

spots.text: At the end of the icy open area. Just perform any advanced trick.

items.title: Perform 3 Advanced Tricks on Vert Ramps

spots.text: After the previous vert ramp, you'll wallride and enter a tunnel with ice crystals. Stick to the left to see the spray can.

After leaving the ice crystal cave, you'll get to an area with multiple monorails. Stick to the left side to find some rainbow tracks (you must have the special bar filled). Follow them to get the film roll, and at the same time you'll see the horn sign appear in the middle of the screen. When it does, press R3.
In plain sight in the next tunnel.

After leaving the tunnel, you'll get to an area with tall snow walls on either side. In this section, wallride the metal walls and perform any three tricks. The gear can be found on the second wallride.

items.title: Perform 3 Wallride Tricks on the Snow Corridor Walls

spots.text: At the end of the level, you'll be chased by a bulldozer. Just hit all ten boosters on the final straight and corner.

items.title: Hit Every Booster During the Chase

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.
Once you take control of the flying drone and start smashing through the glass windows, keep a look out for the spray can on the left side.
During the section where you have to do tricks with the drone to launch missiles at the doors, you'll see enemy drones. Launch missiles at seven of them to destroy them.

items.title: Destroy 7 Police Drones While Riding the Drone

spots.text: It'll be in plain sight on one of the jumps a good way into the section with the blue floor where you have to hit the accelerators.
Self-explanatory. Spend no more than 1:20 in the particle accelerator.

items.title: Charge Up the Particle Accelerator in Under 01:20

spots.text: Once you leave the particle accelerator, the boss will start sending towers of fire at you. Dodge five of them at the last moment.

items.title: Risky Dodge 5 of Brian's Fire Attacks

spots.text: Once you take the jaws from the boss, drive through 20 task force cars.
During the section where you have the jaws and are driving through the cop cars, stick to the right side to see the film roll.
Self-explanatory. Defeat the boss without crashing.
Once you reach the three signs in the city where the track splits into three, take the left path (blue sign). Then, just after you deliver the tofu, stick right to find the gear.

Once you circle back around to the main split in the tracks where the signs are, follow the right path (pink sign). Then, just after delivering the tofu, you'll go through a tunnel. The gear is on the right side inside the tunnel.
After exiting the tunnel where the previous collectible was, stick to the left of the rock in the middle of the icy area (follow the yellow film roll sign).

items.title: Check Both Paths After the Icy Mountain

spots.text: Immediately after the film roll, trick into the track switcher to get the crane to swing around with the spray can.
After circling back around to the main split, take the final path (green sign). After delivering the tofu, you'll use a monorail. Dodge the two red arrow boards at the last second.
. After the monorail, you'll return to the icy part again. This time, stick to the right of the rock.

items.title: Check Both Paths After the Icy Mountain

spots.text: After delivering all three tofus, you'll go through a cave. In this cave, look for a gear sign on the left. If you have your special bar filled up, you'll see a rainbow rail on the left. Take it to find another monorail with two red arrow boards you can risky dodge. This path will also take you underwater for the other dare.
Just past the water where you get the previous dare.

9/10 of these are automatic. However if you take the rainbow path for the previous collectibles you will have to replay the level and go through the gate in the cave, instead of taking the rainbow rail.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
Throughout the level, you'll see small cutouts of Molty the Mole on the tracks. Just hit ten of them. There are way more than ten available.
In plain sight as you go through the first tunnel.
Once you reach the area with water, stick to the left path, and eventually you'll see the spray can on a roof.
Continue through the level and you'll reach a mountain area. Here, you'll go over a jump and see orange water below. Make sure you air stomp to land fast enough to get the gear.

After dodging the massive rock that falls onto the tracks, you'll return to the city. Here, if you have a full special bar, you'll see a rainbow track on your left. Take it, and eventually you'll jump over the bell tower and the horn sign will appear in the middle of the screen. Press R3 at this time.

items.title: Ring the Bell at Time Bell Tower

spots.text: Continue through the level, and you'll go through a tunnel. As you come out the other side, you'll see a track switcher. Hit it with the correct trick (you can see the button combo by pausing the game). If you don't get it this time, there will be more opportunities.

items.title: Activate a Rail Switcher with a Front 180 Impossible

spots.text: Just after the first track switcher, you'll see another one. Activate it to get the crane to swing around the collectible.
Soon after the previous collectible, you'll go down the side of a building mostly made of glass windows. While doing this, use the right analog stick to perform any five tricks.

items.title: Perform 5 Slide Tricks in the Fallen Buildings

spots.text: On the second glass building.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Kanto Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: At the first set of signs, head left, then left again at the next signs. Then, on the next straight, jump up to the left rail to perform the vert jump. After that, you'll collect the toy.

. After the previous toy, you'll circle back around to the straight where you jumped to the rail on the left. This time, continue straight and go around the corner. Then, on the next straight, jump up to the left side rail and take the jump. Once you're up high, jump to the rail on your right to continue around the rooftops. This path will take you to the next two toys.

After the previous toys, you'll circle back around to the rail that you jumped on for the previous collectibles. This time, stick to the track on the left that splits away to the left, then do the same on the next straight. Soon after that, you'll jump over the Shibuya Crossing and see the horn sign on your screen. Press R3 to finish the dare.
After the previous dare, you'll reach the area where you have to complete the orange main objective. Just before the third statue, you'll collect the film roll.
After finishing the orange main quest, you'll go through a tunnel. The spray can will be inside in plain sight.

After the previous can, follow the yellow signs until you reach the main objective. During this objective you'll have to press two switches (just follow the path and you'll eventually get to both). On your way to the right side switch, you'll see the gear as you climb the tall towers.
In plain sight after finishing the yellow main objective.
Next, keep following the green signs. Once you follow it around a track to the left and the green main objective starts, stick to the right rail to get the gear.

After finishing the green main objective, follow the blue signs until you reach a lone track that goes left. Take it, then jump up to the rail on the right (to continue following the blue sign). This path will take you to the top of the red tower, where the toy can be found.

After the previous toy, stop following the blue sign and just stick to the main multi track path until you eventually circle back around to the blue sign that leads you to the lone track on the left you took to get to the previous toy. Take it again, but this time jump to the rail on your left after this corner to perform the vert jump and get the toy.

Follow the blue signs to the blue main objective, and you'll jump off the top of a very tall building. Just chain together ten tricks in the air as you fall. If you're having trouble, you can use the Shikoku Jet Rod train, which has a faster trick speed.

items.title: Chain 10 Tricks after Jumping Off the Sky Needle

spots.text: Self-explanatory.
While on the main multi track, double drift (L2 plus a direction on the left stick), then go around a corner and enter a drift by pressing L2 and letting go in the green area.

items.title: Perform 3 Perfect Drifts while Double Drifting

spots.text: At the start, stick to the right to get the film roll after the first vert jump.
In plain sight just after you leave the bridge.
Continue through the level until you reach a section where you're riding a massive ball. While doing so, jump and perform five tricks.

items.title: Perform 5 Tricks While Riding the Ball

spots.text: After leaving the ball, you'll go through an airport. Here, the massive monster will try to attack you with her tail and foot. Dodge one of the attacks at the last second.

items.title: Risky Dodge Morzilla at the Airport

spots.text: Self-explanatory. After dodging the monster outside the airport, you'll smash through some glass and enter the airport building. Have a x15 combo by this point.

items.title: Enter the Airport Building With Over x15 Combo

spots.text: After leaving the airport and riding a monorail around a corner to the right, you'll see a rainbow track to your right (only if your special bar is filled). Ride it to reach a halfpipe, where you'll find the gear.
At the end of the halfpipe, you'll ride a rainbow vert jump right in front of the monster's face. Here, press the R3 button to blow your horn.
In plain sight after the previous dare.

Continue through the level until a building falls onto the tracks in front of you. You'll see a blue sign pointing you down to a gear. As you jump over the building, perform an air stomp through the glass windows to get the gear.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.
Under the gate just after the first wallride at the start of the level.

After another two billboards on your right that you can wallride, you'll see a sign pointing you left toward a gear. Follow it, then follow the next sign left. After that, a boy will approach you on your left on a bike, and the horn sign will appear in the middle of the screen. Press R3.
Obtained as you go over the next vert jump after the bike boy.
Continue through the level until you reach the port area where you grind a boat. Here, you'll see the gear in a Yukaze.

After the port area, you'll go up a hill and through a tunnel. Once you come out the other side, look out for a yellow sign pointing you left toward the film roll. Follow the rainbow path to get it (must have full special).
Continue through the level and you'll reach a section with halfpipes and monorails on each side. Use these to perform ten tricks.
During the halfpipe section with monorails. Stick to the right side to find the spray can.

After the spray can, you'll enter a building. As soon as you do, stick to the left (you'll see a white flag with the onsen icon on it). Then, after this, jump to the rainbow track on the left and follow it to the end.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Hakone Onsen
levels.note: This level will only be available if you found the Onsen Exit in level 7-4-1. Exhaust the dialogue and leave.

spots.text: At the very start, jump over to the track on the right that separates away. This will take you through a tunnel with the cup noodle.
Once you come out the other side of the tunnel, stick to the left side and take the vert jump. Then, after going through two rideable walls, you'll get the cup noodle.
After the previous cup noodle, you'll go through a dome shaped structure. On the other side, ride the middle yellow rail. You'll then see the cup noodle on the rightmost track.

You'll now circle back to the straight after the tunnel where you got the first cup noodle, and you should have your special bar filled by now. This time, stick to the right side and follow the track that looks like it's going to end in the water, with a rideable wall on the other side. Just as you're getting to the end, the zeppelin will fall in front of you, allowing you to cross.
After bouncing off the zeppelin, ride the walls without falling down, and you'll collect both collectibles.
Soon after the previous collectibles, you'll go under the dome structure again. Once you come out the other side, stick to the right side track, and the building will get destroyed.
On the wallride immediately after the building falls.
After the previous noodle, look out for a rainbow rail on the left. Follow it until you see the gear on your right.
On the tracks after the previous gear as you circle back to the start. Hard to miss.
Once you get back to the start again, jump to the destroyed ferris wheel on the left side to finish the dare.

items.title: Lure Panzeta to Destroy the Ferris Wheel

spots.text: After the ferris wheel, stick to the two tracks going left to find the gear.
After the gear, take the monorails on the right, and then after the wallride, look for the track on the right with the film sign. Follow it to get the film roll.
Self-explanatory.
At the start, stick to the left and take the vert ramp. Then continue down this path until you see the spray can in the middle of the tracks, just as you dodge an obstacle with an air stomp.
After the next wallride, you'll see some wrecking balls swinging over the track. The last crane will be swinging the gear on the end of the rope instead of a wrecking ball.
Soon after the previous collectible, you'll see the spray can below you after a rail. Air stomp down to it.
Continue down the path after the spray can, and you'll soon go through an underwater tunnel. Here, do a full loop around it.

After the tunnel, you'll cross a long bridge that gets destroyed by Morzilla, and you'll be underwater again. After that, you'll jump over her face with a Yukaze. Activate it at the perfect time by waiting for the yellow circle.

items.title: Perform a Perfect Yukaze over Morzilla's Face

spots.text: After jumping over Morzilla's head later in the level, you'll see the film roll in front of you. You'll need to ride the rainbow track that appears in front of you if you have the special bar filled.

Once the robot saves you from Morzilla and you air stomp her head, continue a little further and you'll see a green sign pointing you right to a spray can as you go from a monorail to a Yukaze. Go to the right and smash through the glass to get it.
After the previous collectible, you'll ride a monorail, and Morzilla's head will block your path. Dodge by swinging right at the very last second.

items.title: Risky Dodge Morzilla's Head on a Monorail

spots.text: Soon after the previous dare, you'll jump over Morzilla's tail and then go over a vert jump. Press the R3 button to honk during this jump.

items.title: Honk Morzilla Goodbye on the Last Vert Ramp

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Odawara Castle
levels.note: This is a shop level. New Trains and Stickers will be available to purchase.

levels.name: Gothic Race Ring
levels.song: What a Horrible Night to Drive a Train
levels.note: For this race I recommend using the Forest DX Train. You'll need to get your special bar filled up very quickly if you want to get everything in one run. If not, you can just collect everything over multiple runs.

spots.text: On the rail on the left of the track after the first corner.
Once you enter the castle, you'll go through a halfpipe. At the end of the halfpipe, take the rail on the right to collect the coffin.
After the previous coffin, you'll hang onto a monorail. If you have your special bar filled up, swing to the rainbow Yukaze on the left to reach the gear on the rideable wall.
. After the gear, you'll see the coffin in plain sight as you go through the tunnel.
After the tunnel, you'll see three narrow glass windows at the end of the track. Break one on each of the three laps.
As soon as you smash through the windows, use the rainbow Yukaze to reach the rainbow monorail above, where you'll collect the spray can.
Once you reach the halfpipe in the castle on your second lap, you'll be able to get the spray can by circling around the top of the rainbow tunnel.
This time, ride the rail on the left at the end of the halfpipe. Then, on the monorail, swing to the rainbow rail on the right to get the gear.
During the final lap, after the halfpipe, you'll go through a cave. Stick to the left to get the film roll.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.
. At the very start of the level, double drift on the double tracks as much as you can. You'll get 200 quickly. This dare does seem to be bugged, and I had to do this multiple times until it counted.

items.title: Score 200 Double Drift Points in the Dark Forest

spots.text: Progress through the level until you enter a cave with a green sign pointing you right to a spray can. Inside the cave, stick to the right path to find it.
Soon after the cave, the camera will change angle and you'll see Sei's projection in the background. Press the R3 button to use your horn.

items.title: Interrupt Sei with Your Own Instrument

spots.text: After the previous dare, you'll go around a corner and have to jump over a building. As you do this, air stomp to break the glass below, where the film roll is.
After the previous collectible, you'll ride a monorail through a glass window into another building. Here, you'll see the gear on the left.
Self-explanatory. Reach the actual boss fight with a x20 combo or more.

items.title: Reach the Stadium with Over x20 Combo

spots.text: The boss fight is basically a rhythm mini game. Don't miss more than five notes. This can be a little challenging, and you may have to retry multiple times. Remember to look out for the pink vertical notes on the sides and double drift through the notes that take up multiple tracks.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.
After the first straight, the tracks will split. Take the right side track, and you'll soon find the gear.
Once you enter the tunnel, you'll get the tutorial about gravity switches. To perform one, press R2 twice. For the dare, press R2, perform any trick, and then press R2 again.
After the tunnel, you'll cross a falling bridge. Just double drift at any point while going over it.

items.title: Double Drift on the Falling Bridge

spots.text: Continue through the level until you wallride and then jump to a gravity monorail, then go through a small temple. As you do this, drop down to the area below with an air stomp to get the spray can.
In plain sight after riding a monorail in the city. Jump up to the Yukaze to reach it.

After the previous collectible, you'll reach a straight with a green sign pointing up to a spray can. If you have the special meter filled, you'll see a rainbow track up above you that you can gravity switch to. Follow it to eventually get the spray can.
In plain sight in the middle of the icy area.
Immediately after the icy area, you'll grind up three chains. Dodge one of the red arrow boards at the last second.

items.title: Risky Dodge in the Last Chain Climb

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
As you reach the first signs while riding the gravity monorail, drop off to the track below and continue straight to get the collectible.
After the previous collectible, take the track that goes left (follow the pink sign). You'll eventually reach a halfpipe with the gear on the right.
After the previous gear, you'll reach an area where you ride a log and enter a sawmill. As you go through it, you'll have to dodge multiple saws. Dodge three of them at the last second.
In plain sight as you go through the sawmill.
Come out the other side of the sawmill without crashing.

Once you circle back around to the start of the level, do the same as last time and get off the monorail to continue straight on the track below. This time, continue straight and follow the blue and green signs, where you'll get the collectible.

After the previous collectible, stick to the left and follow the green sign. Follow this path, and once the track becomes three tracks, you'll see two rideable walls on your right. The collectible will be on the second one. Use the rail on the left if you're having trouble getting to it.
Now follow the green signs until you reach the part where you have to roll the snowball. As you roll it through the ice fields, you'll see the gear in plain sight.
After rolling the snowball, you'll ride it down the hill. While doing this, perform three hardcore tricks. You can see the list of tricks in the Tricktionary in the pause menu.

items.title: Perform 3 Hardcore Tricks on the Snowball

spots.text: You'll see it as you ride the snowball. You can reach it by jumping to it.
Follow the green signs until you go through the greenhouse. At one point you'll go through a tunnel where you'll see the spray can in plain sight.
Hard to miss. As you go through the greenhouse, you'll see track switchers as you take some jumps. Just trick through them to activate the sprinklers.

levels.name: Tohoku Fanzine H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

spots.text: You'll see it floating in the air after the first jump. You can reach it with a jump.
If you collected the previous card, you'll see a track going into the mouth of the dragon at the top of the next hill where the rideable wall is. Go through it.
After riding the first magnetic purple track on the ceiling, you'll ride some rails over water. Here, you'll see the film roll on the right.
Just after the previous collectible, stick to the right.
After the previous card, you'll ride another upside down magnetic track, and immediately after that, ride the wall on the right to get the spray can.
After the previous collectible, stick left and go up to the magnetic track above you. Stick right to go through the upside down halfpipe, where you'll see the card.
Just after the previous card, you'll take a vert jump and land on triple tracks. Stick to the right one to get the card.
Once you jump into the icy pachinko machine, use the right analog stick to perform ten tricks. They don't need to all be during the same lap.

items.title: Perform 10 Ice Slide Tricks on the Pachinko

spots.text: On the left side in the icy pachinko machine.
Leave the ice pachinko area via the tracks on the left. Then you'll use a monorail and see two Yukaze. Use the one on the left to get up to another magnetic track, where you'll find a card.

Once you reach the second lap, after the first corner, use the jump to reach the upside down rainbow tracks (only if you have your special bar filled up). You'll see the spray can on it around the first corner.
On the left just after the water area with the rolling balls.
After the previous card, stay on the bottom tracks and go through the dragon's mouth.
Once you reach the halfpipes area again, you'll find it in the left side bottom one.
On the right side once you reach the icy pachinko area.
After leaving the pachinko ring again and reaching the two Yukaze, this time use the one on the right to get to the right side upside down track, where the card will be.

Once you start the last lap, do as you did on the second one and use the first jump to get up to the upside down rainbow tracks. Then continue on them and go through the dragon's mouth, which should now be open.
Once you reach the water area with the rolling balls, stick to the right side and look out for the rainbow track. Follow it to get the gear.
Once you leave the ice pachinko area for the last time, look out for a dragon with its mouth open on the right side. Go through it.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.
Throughout the level, you'll see money collection boxes. There are way more than ten, and they're hard to miss.
Play through the level until you use an upside down purple gravity track. The gear will be on the right side of it.
During the section with water, you'll ride an upside down purple gravity track. Then, once you return to the ground, the spray can will be on the rideable wall on your left.
In plain sight after the jump at the end of the water section.
After the previous collectible, the camera will change, and you'll be chased by one of the twins as you grind a rail. Just use the right analog stick to perform any trick.

items.title: Perform a Grind Trick While Being Chased by a Twin

spots.text: Continue through the level until you return to the city. Here, you'll use multiple Yukaze to reach an upside down purple track. As soon as you reach the purple track, move to the rainbow track on your left (you'll need the energy bar filled up). Then follow this track to get the film roll.
In the next underground tunnel, where you have to dodge the blue vines.
After leaving the tunnel, you'll jump over a massive statue and ride a crest (horn looking thing). During this section, jump and perform any hardcore trick.

items.title: Perform 1 Hardcore Trick With the Samurai Crest

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Perform any three tricks while going up to or coming down from purple tracks.

items.title: Perform Tricks While Gravity Switching 3 Times

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

As soon as you start, jump to one of the left two tracks and follow this path until you grind and then wallride on the left side wall. After that, you'll go over a jump to the area below. As you do this jump, don't press any directions, so you fall onto the lowest track. Then, after the corner, jump to the rail on the left to collect the spray can.
Almost immediately after the spray can, you'll see a Scrap Salvage above a tire. Collect it and air stomp on the tire.
Continue on this track, and you'll eventually jump over the other tire. Air stomp it, then go right to the spray can and follow the right side track.
Follow the track on the right after the previous can, and you'll see the collectible up against a rideable wall on your left.
Immediately after the previous collectible, stick to the left, and you'll go over a vert jump. Perform two hardcore tricks while going over it.

items.title: Chain 2 Hardcore Tricks on Vert Ramps

spots.text: After the vert jump, you'll jump over a small wall. On the other side, stick to the right side track to get the gear.

After the previous gear, you'll go through a halfpipe and then go over a vert jump. Then, after that, stick to the track on the right side. This will take you over a rail, and then you'll see the film roll on the rideable wall on your left.
After the film roll, jump over the wall and stay on the right side track. This will take you back to the halfpipe and allow you to get the scrap on the left side rail.

After leaving the halfpipe for the second time, repeat the path to the film roll again. This time, after you jump over the wall, stay on the middle track, and you'll then see the scrap before going up the slope to a vert jump.
After the previous collectible, you'll go over the vert jump. Follow this path, and eventually you'll jump off the top of a building, where you'll collect the scrap.

After the jump where you get the previous collectible, land on the left side track (where you got a previous scrap on a wall) and take the left side vert jump. Then, when jumping over the wall, stick to the left side track. This will take you to another three track path. Stick to the right side track at all times. Then, eventually, after a vert jump, you'll grind a rail and see a rainbow rail in front of you. Take it to get the gear.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory.

items.title: Chain 5 Tricks in a Single Jump

spots.text: On the rideable wall on the left after going through the waterfall.
After coming out of the cave with the halfpipes, you'll go through a short underwater section. Once you reach the multi tracks, perform a double drift.
After leaving the water and jumping over a statue, you'll see a gear sign pointing left. Stick to the left track to find the gear.
Soon you'll reach a section where you ride a skateboard. Here, destroy five boxes. They're hanging on the sides of the halfpipes and in the middle of the path.
In the middle of the area close to the start of the skateboard section.
Soon after the skateboard section, you'll ride a short yellow rail, and then you'll see the spray can on your right.
Almost immediately after the previous can, you'll see a spray can sign and a rainbow monorail above you (must have the special bar filled). Follow the rainbow path to eventually reach the spray can.

To find the exit, you'll have to play through the level again, since you can't get the last spray can and find the exit on the same run. Play through the level until you reach the rainbow monorail path (same one as where the final spray can was), but this time look out for a white flag with the onsen image on it to the left, where you can get off the rainbow track and jump to a normal track. Follow that track to reach the Onsen Exit.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.

levels.name: Nyuto Onsen
levels.note: This level will only be available if you found the Onsen Exit in level 8-5-1. Exhaust the dialogue and leave.

levels.name: Hirosaki Castle
levels.note: Shop level with new Trains and Stickers available to purchase.

spots.text: Throughout the first section of the level, you'll jump over giant drums. Whenever you do so, air stomp down to bounce off them. They're all on the main path and hard to miss.
Once the tracks split at the start of the level, take the right path, and you'll reach the spray can.
Once the archer gets in front of you and you have to gravity switch between the tracks to dodge the arrows, time one of the switches to get the gear in the middle.
After the previous gear, the archer will start to shoot arrows into the tracks. Here, just before driving into the arrows, dodge them.

Once you reach the double boss in the clouds, defeat them as soon as possible. You'll have to press up and down on the d-pad to change your charge between positive and negative. Just drive through the symbols with the same charge as you to damage the boss. Remember you can drive through more than one per attack.

items.title: Beat the Twins in the Clouds in Under 1:50

spots.text: After the double boss, you'll fight another boss. Every now and then you'll have to jump through and smash a skeleton hand. Just do any hardcore trick while smashing one of these hands.

items.title: Smash a Skeleton Hand with a Hardcore Trick

spots.text: During the 2D section where you have to use the gravity tracks to stay in the air and dodge the ghost hands, almost as if you were playing Flappy Bird. The film roll is hard to miss.
Self-explanatory. Finish the level without crashing.
At the very start, jump up to the rail on the left to continue straight. Follow this path, and you'll eventually get the spray can.
After going through the first underwater section, look out for the gear on the right side of the icy area.
Continue through the level until you go through a small town. Here, the camera will move to your side, and you'll jump over a wave. Perform any hardcore trick over it.

items.title: Perform a Hardcore Trick Over a Wave

spots.text: During the waves section, you'll bounce on large yellow jellyfish in the water. Just air stomp one of them.

items.title: Air Stomp on the Radioactive Medusas

spots.text: After riding some purple upside down gravity tracks where you have to dodge oncoming enemy trains, you'll go around a left hand corner and then see a yellow sign pointing left to a film roll. Here, drop down to the normal track below and then follow the rainbow track to the left (must have your special bar filled).
Once you enter the large metallic building where you go under the massive mole statue, you'll have to dodge lasers. Just dodge ten of them at the last moment.
In plain sight in the laser tunnel where they spin around the inside of the tunnel.
In the next part of the laser tunnel, above the lasers making an X shape. Jump over them to get it.
Self-explanatory.
Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.

levels.name: Hokkaido Intel H.Q.
levels.note: Fill the comic book up with the film rolls to get the (EN)Zine. You will not be able to do this on your first visit, since some of the required film rolls are collected in later levels. Come back after collecting every film in the chapter.

levels.name: 10 Seconds To Revolution
levels.song: Densha ni notte ne! ~電車に乗ってね!~

spots.text: After leaving the first tunnel with boosters, you'll go through a few Yukaze. Make sure you hit at least three of them perfectly. Make sure you do it before getting to the second tunnel with boosters.

items.title: Perform 3 Perfect Yukaze in Sendai's Dome

spots.text: Soon after leaving the first tunnel with boosters and dodging some trucks, you'll reach a road where you have to grind on rails that are on top of lines of moving trucks. On this road, watch out for a moving wall on the right side that's rideable. The spray can will be on that wall.
In plain sight as you go through the second tunnel with the boosters you activate with your horn.
. After leaving the second tunnel, you'll ride the worm boss a few times. Quickly do three tricks with the right analog stick.

items.title: Grind Trick 3 Times on the Worm in Tokyo's Dome

spots.text: In the tunnel that you follow the worm boss through.
After going through the inside of the castle boss, you'll get blasted out the other side. While flying through the air, use your horn with the R3 button.
After getting launched out of the castle, you'll go through another tunnel with boosters. In this tunnel, look out for the gear on the right side just after riding a monorail.
Continue through the level until the robot launches you up to the sky and onto some buildings. The film roll will be on the left side building after the first building.
Get a x20 combo in the section after the robot launches you up to the buildings in the clouds.

items.title: Pull a 20 Trick Combo Over the Clouds

spots.text: Self-explanatory. Get to the end of the level without crashing.
After launching into space, you'll land on a rainbow road. Use the right analog stick to slide trick ten times.

items.title: Slide Trick 10 Times While in the Aurora

spots.text: On the aurora (rainbow road), once the road starts to get wavy during the section with the lasers, stick right to find the final gear.
Once you get off the aurora and land on a track, gravity switch to the purple grind above you, where you'll pick up the spray can.
Soon after the previous spray can, you'll jump and hit the side of a satellite. During this jump, perform any hardcore trick.

items.title: Hit the Satellite With a Hardcore Trick

spots.text: Immediately after the satellite jump, you'll enter an upside down halfpipe. At the end of the halfpipe, you'll see a spray can sign pointing right. Exit this halfpipe via the right side to land in another halfpipe with the spray can in it.
After wallriding the satellites, you'll go through a short tunnel where the final film roll can be found.
The final spray can of the game will be in plain sight in one of the yellow diamond shaped holes you can go through in the large blue barriers as you approach the moon.
After Sei comes to save the day, you'll enter a massive structure, and inside you'll smash through some structures. Perform hardcore tricks while destroying five of them.

items.title: Trick 5 Times While Smashing Moon Structures

spots.text: Get to the end of the level without crashing.

medalTips: Use grind and monorail tricks to easily boost multiplier.
You can jump off a wall ride, do a hardcore trick, then jump back on. This is easy to exploit.
Stale tricks give significantly less score so learn a trick sequence and perform it throughout each level.
Always manual between tricks. Don't worry too much about perfect manuals (you can just hold your stick up/down so it auto manuals when landing).

discrepancies.text: The guide and the trophy (Ultimate Challenger, 0/325) say 325 dares, 5 in each of the 65 levels, but the guide lists only 321: levels 2-3-B, 5-4-1, 8-1-1, 9-2-B have 4 each.

The results screens in the Steam artwork 'Levels overview 1.0' show 7/7 dares for 1-2-1 and 1-3-1, and 8/8 for 3-2-2, while the guide lists 5 in each. The guide says some dares are about collecting the other items, which may explain the gap.
